description: This file is a PHP class defining the admin controller for managing product attributes in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, deleting, and autocompleting attribute data.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Controller class for managing product attributes within the admin panel of OpenCart, with functionalities for CRUD operations and autocomplete.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main page loader; sets up the view with attribute list and layout components.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of attribute groups with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission for adding or editing an attribute group.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected attribute groups after permission check.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides attribute data for autocomplete functionality.
